card.title: Protected Equity Portfolio
card.body: A protected equity strategy built from ASX Top 50 positions, where every holding carries downside protection through a collar.

hero.title: Protected Equity Portfolio
hero.subtitle: Top 50 equity participation with every position capital-protected, enhanced by a measured 20% gearing overlay.

statement.title: Equity participation, with the downside contractually capped.
points: Each Top 50 position is capital-protected close to 98% through a bought put, so large, sudden falls are sidestepped rather than ridden out.
A 20% overlay on an already-protected book lifts participation without exposing capital to the uncapped drawdowns of geared, unprotected equity.
Quarterly income near the Top 50 yield, plus franking credits and profits from closed collar trades.
statement.footnote: Full strategy detail, including modelled results and assumptions, is in the strategy paper — available on request

about.title: About the strategy
about.body: Selected Top 50 stocks held near index weights, each capital-protected with a bought put part-funded by strategic call selling — an actively managed collar, reset quarterly, with a 20% gearing overlay applied to the protected book. Run by specialists in exchange-traded options, with the same oversight discipline as the Arculus public funds.

atAGlance.title: At a glance
atAGlance.note: Terms are indicative and confirmed in mandate documentation.
items: ASX Top 50 stocks with listed options

processRiskControls.title: Process & risk controls
items: The universe is filtered for liquid exchange-traded option markets, with OTC options used where ASX cover is unavailable.
Stocks are ranked on expected-return groups, up and down beta, volatility skew and dividend timing.
Stock, protective put and sold call combinations are tested over one to three months against return hurdles.
No stock enters the book unprotected. Every position is capital-protected close to 98%, with put cost offset by sold calls.

keyRisks.title: Key risks
paragraphs: Derivatives and gearing are leveraged: gains and losses are magnified, and investors may lose substantially more than their initial investment. The 20% overlay increases both potential return and risk, and outcomes depend on the borrowing-cost assumption used.

Protection is set per position at close to 98%, not at portfolio level, and sold calls cap the upside within each quarter. This is not a capital-guaranteed investment, and past performance — including modelled results — is not a reliable indicator of future performance.
